# sample_representative_mofdb { #mofography.data.sample_representative_mofdb }

```python
data.sample_representative_mofdb(
    df,
    n,
    strat_cols=None,
    n_bins=4,
    random_state=0,
)
```

Sample a representative set of N materials from a MOFdb-style dataframe using
proportional stratified sampling so the sample's marginal distributions match
the population over the given columns (e.g. surface area, void fraction, LCD, PLD).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                                          | Default    |
|--------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df           |        | DataFrame with MOFdb-style columns (e.g. surface_area_m2g, void_fraction, lcd, pld). | _required_ |
| n            |        | Target number of materials to sample.                                                | _required_ |
| strat_cols   |        | List of column names to stratify on. Defaults to MOFDB_STRAT_COLS.                   | `None`     |
| n_bins       |        | Number of quantile-based bins per column for stratification.                         | `4`        |
| random_state |        | Random seed for reproducibility.                                                     | `0`        |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                            |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------|
|        |        | DataFrame of sampled rows (materials). |
